notes: take the bottom output alone and you get the mix of all four channels; take a middle output and the chain is cut there, so the channels above become one mix and the channels below another
put a second GOMA II immediately to its right and this one's running sum passes into that one's top channel, chaining the two into one longer mixer; the light beside the top channel comes on
the panel prints 5V beside each input because that is what an unpatched input reads; the Normalled input voltage menu can change it to 10V, and the panel does not follow
